name: ES Futures: Gap-Up Fill Probability Analysis
description: Analyzes the historical probability of ES (E-Mini S&P 500) price returning to touch the previous day's high when the session opens above the prior session's range (gap-up). Computes fill rate, gap size statistics, and a rolling 252-day fill rate over time. Uses daily bars only — no futures continuation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES FUTURES: GAP-UP FILL PROBABILITY ANALYSIS
# Daily bars | No futures continuation
#
# Gap-up  = today's open > previous day's high
# Fill    = today's low <= previous day's high (price returns to touch pHigh)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
open_p = src.o
high   = src.h
low    = src.l

# === PREVIOUS DAY HIGH ===
prev_high = high >> 1

# =============================================================================
# CORE FLAGS
# =============================================================================

# Gap-up flag: 1.0 on days where open is strictly above previous day's high
gap_up_flag = (1.0 if open_p > prev_high else 0.0)

# Fill flag: 1.0 on gap-up days where today's low trades back to touch/cross pHigh
fill_flag = (1.0 if (gap_up_flag > 0.5 and low <= prev_high) else 0.0)

# Fill rate: sparse series — defined only on gap-up days (null otherwise)
# Mean of this sparse series = historical fill probability
fill_rate = where(gap_up_flag > 0.5, fill_flag)

# =============================================================================
# GAP SIZE SERIES
# =============================================================================

# Gap size on ALL gap-up days (open - prev_high, points)
gap_size = where(gap_up_flag > 0.5, open_p - prev_high)

# Gap size only on FILLED gap-up days
gap_size_filled = where(fill_flag > 0.5, open_p - prev_high)

# Gap size only on UNFILLED gap-up days
gap_size_unfilled = where(gap_up_flag > 0.5 and fill_flag < 0.5, open_p - prev_high)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING 252-DAY FILL RATE
# rolling fills / rolling gap-up days over past year
# =============================================================================

rolling_gap_sum  = sum(period=252)(gap_up_flag)
rolling_fill_sum = sum(period=252)(fill_flag)
rolling_fill_rate = rolling_fill_sum / rolling_gap_sum

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 1: SUMMARY CARDS
# gap_up_flag used twice: Count → total analyzable bars, Sum → gap-up day count
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='ES Futures — Gap-Up Fill Probability',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Bars',                  card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Gap-Up Days',                 card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fill Count',                  card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fill Probability',            card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Gap Size Filled (pts)',   card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Gap Size Unfilled (pts)', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,  type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Gap Fill Analysis'
)(gap_up_flag, gap_up_flag, fill_flag, fill_rate, gap_size_filled, gap_size_unfilled)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 2: GAP SIZE HISTOGRAM (all gap-up days)
# =============================================================================

histogram(
    title='Gap Size Distribution — All Gap-Up Days',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Gap Size (Points)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    category='Gap Fill Analysis',
    show_analytics=True,
    fill_color=Color.Info,
    fill_opacity=0.75
)(gap_size)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 3: ROLLING 252-DAY FILL RATE (TV chart pane)
# Shows how fill probability evolves across different market regimes
# =============================================================================

timeseries_lines(
    title='Rolling 252-Day Gap Fill Rate',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252-Day Fill Rate', color=Color.Info)
    ])
)(rolling_fill_rate)
